description: Call before taking any action for a system that has a Jugular (a human-held kill switch, id JG-XXXX-XXXX). Returns live true or false. If live is false, or the check fails, do not act: the human holding the switch has stopped this system (EU AI Act Article 14(4)(e) stop button). Read-only.
name: sebbi_jugular_check
title: Check the human kill switch
